title: Wand selection
description: Selecting two NPCs with the wand and clearing the selection

console: animus create greeter name=Greeter world=world x=-2.5 y=64 z=-9.5
animus create trader type=minecraft:llama name=Trader world=world x=4.5 y=64 z=-9.5

beats.note: 2.5 blocks from the greeter, inside wand reach

beats.result: the glinting Animus wand lands in hand
the line above the hotbar reads Selected Greeter, and the greeter glows a moment
the line above the hotbar reads Added Trader, 2 selected
chat lists the greeter and the trader

beats.note: away from every NPC, so the click finds none

beats.caption: Sneak and right-click the air clears it

beats.result: the line above the hotbar reads Selection cleared

closing: Left-click selects the greeter, sneak and click adds the trader, sneak and right-click clears
